title: The make targets hide the tool commands from a person reading along
foundBy: user report (host): "we haven't really shown the tools to the users themselves. this may be ok if we only expect agents to use the tools, but may be hard if a human is trying to review them for the first time"
details:
Most recipes start with `@`, so the command is silent. The ones that print show a long line of `PATH=` and `CS_SANDBOX_BIN=` settings, with the useful part at the far end. The only demonstration also needs a Fireworks key, a Go toolchain, podman and half an hour.

A reader's own project will not have this Makefile, so the tool commands are what the repository has to teach.
